engines_100pct_initialize.note: 5/14 registered swap engines initialize and execute on TensorRT. 9/14 cannot: weights do not exist, so 100% is impossible without acquiring files.

detection_gt_99pct.note: Frames-with-detection over 3432 evaluated frames = 92.07% (analyzer path), 91.67% (tracker path). 6/12 clips are 100%; s1 98.54; s5-s10 77-89%. Remaining misses inspected are overwhelmingly back-of-head / hand-occluded (no face). That is NOT recall; no ground truth exists. False positives on back-of-head ears (s7, s9, s10) inflate the hit rate, so true recall of VISIBLE faces is unknown; plausibly >99% but not demonstrated.

faceset.limits: FLAME blocked; 5-point landmarks only; profile views 0 and 4 got view gain ~0.64 (heavy lighting correction)

preview_swap.s11_f30: OK on inswapper_128 (59 s cold) and hyperswap_1a_256 (5.5 s) via POST /api/v1/workstation/preview, CUDA provider; face visibly changed (preview_s11_compare.jpg)
preview_swap.s3_f60: 422 PREVIEW_TRACK_MISSING: head lying sideways, estimated yaw -80 deg; face is tracked and swap_allowed but session.py auto-3D path hits `fade <= 0 -> continue` and returns zero replacements with no `withheld` entry; error text misleadingly says no mapped face is visible. First attempt also hit PREVIEW_BUDGET (120 s) on cold models.

detection.method: Per sampled frame: media.analyzer.analyze (RobustDetector-wrapped detector, UI/target-lock path, thresholds 0.5/0.3) and sequential FaceTracker(identity-lock policy) as in MediaService.inspect. All frames when clip <=400 frames, else stride 2-4 (s5 /3, s6 /4, s7 /2, s8 /2).

miss_classification.s1: 3 misses = hand covering the face (genuine occlusion)
miss_classification.s5/s6/s7/s9/s10: contiguous back-of-head / ear-only turntable spans (genuine no-face). Borderline possibly-real: s6 f364,368 (profile outline; tracker had it, analyzer did not), s10 f295/296 (raw 0.43), s7 f124-130 (cheek), s5 f312-324 (glasses sliver; tracker coasted).

detection.false_positive_evidence: sheets/lowscore_hits_precision.png: score 0.32-0.50 boxes sit on the EAR/back of head in s9 (4/4 sampled), s7 (3/4), s10 (2/4). Low-score-only hit frames: s1 7, s2 16, s5 11, s6 6, s7 11, s9 9, s10 24. If all s7/s9/s10 low-score hits were false: s7 73%, s9 84%, s10 77%.

known_open_issues: 9 swappers have no weights (simswap_256/512, ghost_256_unet_1-3, blendswap_256, uniface_256, realswap_256/512).
Back-of-head false positives (ear boxes at score 0.3-0.5) in s7/s9/s10 pass FaceAnalyzer's tolerant tier and would be swapped onto the ear.
Preview returns PREVIEW_TRACK_MISSING (misleading) for tracked faces beyond the 3D yaw limit when pose fade is 0; no withheld reason recorded.
Cold preview exceeds the 120 s PREVIEW_BUDGET (first TensorRT builds).
face_occluder.onnx TensorRT/CUDA failure (audit item) not re-verified here.
ONNX Runtime 'Conv running in Fallback mode' warnings during detection slow 4K scans (~0.5-1 s/frame).
Tracker was run on strided frames for s5-s8 so its coasting behaviour there is not representative.
Preview refuses frames > 3840x2160 pixels, so 4096x2160 clips (s4, s5, s6) get PREVIEW_SIZE_BUDGET.
phase2_recommendations: Acquire weights (or drop the 9 ids from the UI) rather than claim 100%; wire hififace/crossface via a supported_models.json spec since weights exist.
Replace/alias inswapper_128_fp16 with a real FP16 export or hide the duplicate.
Add back-of-head/ear rejection to the tolerant tier (eyes inside box, 106pt agreement >= 0.8) and re-measure.
Hand-label ~200 frames (s5-s10 transitions) for a real recall/precision number; stop using frames-with-detection as the KPI.
Return a withheld/skip reason when pose fade removes a swap; fix PREVIEW_TRACK_MISSING wording.
Pre-warm TensorRT engines at startup so previews stay under 120 s.
